title: Neko locations
description: A divider row, a big soft-serif heading, then a swipeable row of tall rounded photo cards running off the right edge: a frosted city chip at the top, the clinic's name in serif and its street at the foot over a soft dark fade. Under it, thin prev/next arrows either side of a hairline progress bar. Card captions fade in as the row scrolls into view.
notes: native horizontal scrolling with snap; the arrows and progress bar need JavaScript
captions are background-coloured (white on the neko theme) over a foreground fade: use photos, or the slate placeholders
name: neko-locations
